approach: Extend the check wait in `land_pr` (crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs) from one loop into three phases sharing one look budget. Phase 1 is the existing loop. If it ends Red, phase 2 reads the commit's workflow runs until none is still running, names the failing test from the failed job's log, then calls `POST actions/runs/{id}/rerun-failed-jobs` once per failed run. Phase 3 polls checks again and ignores a result until `run_attempt` shows the run restarted. Green merges through the unchanged gate. Red or Pending stops with no merge and no second rerun. `PrReport` carries `reruns` and `failing_test`. New `PrHost` methods (`ci_runs`, `rerun_failed`, `failing_test`) go through the existing `GhClient::api` retry and error-log path under `HostOperation::ReadChecks`, the operation `rerun_pages` already uses because the operation list is closed. `api` is split so a plain-text log can use the same path. Display and docs report the test name and the single rerun. Round 2 change: criterion 7 now has a fails_without.

decisions.choice: Keep PrHost::checks returning Checks; add separate ci_runs, rerun_failed and failing_test methods.
decisions.reason: Existing fakes and the Green path keep working, and tests can count reads, runs and reruns separately.

rejected.option: Make checks return a struct carrying runs and the test name
rejected.why: Changes every caller and puts a log fetch into every poll, including Green.

decisions.choice: Phase 2 waits for completion using ci_runs (GET actions/runs?head_sha=...).
decisions.reason: GitHub refuses rerun-failed-jobs on a run still in progress; checks can be Red while sibling jobs run. This is the premature-Red cause.

rejected.option: Rerun as soon as checks go Red
rejected.why: The call is refused in progress and would not give the final result.

decisions.choice: Share one look budget: phases 1 and 2 together get N looks (phase 2 at least 1), phase 3 gets N; total about 2N.
decisions.reason: Meets the accepted bound without changing Poll or wiring.

decisions.choice: In phase 3 ignore a checks read until every rerun run shows run_attempt above its prior value; if the reply has no run_attempt, accept after 2 looks; if never restarted, end Pending.
decisions.reason: Right after the POST the commit still shows the old Red; taking it as final would report a stale failure. Pending never merges.

rejected.option: Accept a stale Red after the allowance
rejected.why: Could report a failure the rerun already cleared.

decisions.choice: Take the failing test name from the failed job's plain-text log (GET actions/jobs/{id}/logs, jobs from actions/runs/{id}/jobs?filter=latest) via pure parser failing_test_name(&str): first `test <name> ... FAILED`, else first `---- <name> stdout ----`; names with chars outside [A-Za-z0-9_:] are dropped; name length limited. Read before the rerun and kept as fallback.
decisions.reason: Only the log carries test names; the filter keeps log text out of the report.

rejected.why: Empty for plain cargo test steps.

decisions.choice: Rerun every failed or timed-out completed run once, recorded as reruns: 1.
decisions.reason: Smallest rule covering more than one workflow; merge gate and one-retry limit hold.

rejected.why: Another failing workflow would keep the PR Red.

decisions.choice: Leave exit-code mapping, Poll and wiring unchanged beyond compile needs.
decisions.reason: Red still exits 2, Green 0; the bound comes from Poll.attempts.

steps: Split GhClient::api into api_text (retry/log loop returning text) and api (parse JSON) with no behaviour change.

Add ci_runs, rerun_failed, failing_test to PrHost and implement on GhClient under HostOperation::ReadChecks.

Extend FakeHost (scripted checks, runs by rerun state, rerun counter, log-derived name, run looks at rerun) and add tests for criteria 1-4.

risks.risk: Phase 1 ends Red on its last look, leaving 1 look for the completion wait.
risks.mitigation: Phase 2 always gets at least 1 look; an unfinished run reports Red with no rerun; stated in docs.

risks.risk: Log text puts unexpected content into the failing test name.
risks.mitigation: Parser accepts only [A-Za-z0-9_:] names, first match, length limited.
Only GhClient and the gh.rs FakeHost implement it; cargo test compiles the workspace.
A refusal surfaces through the error log with its status; report stays Red, nothing merges.

demonstrations.method: Unit test in gh.rs. FakeHost scripts checks [Red, ...] and ci_runs in_progress for the first looks, then completed; it records how many ci_runs looks had happened at each rerun_failed. attempts >= 4.
demonstrations.observes: Zero reruns while the run is in progress; exactly one rerun_failed, made only after the completed look; check reads <= 2 x attempts.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the wait for completion the rerun fires at the first Red with the run still in progress, so the recorded run state is in_progress and the test fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit test with checks [Red, Red, Pending, Red]; ci_runs attempt 1 until rerun, then 1 on the first look afterwards (stale), 2 from the next.
demonstrations.observes: Phase 1 makes 1 read, phase 3 makes 3 reads, 4 in all; one rerun_failed; stale Red not taken as final; report Red with reruns 1; no second rerun.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the run_attempt staleness check, phase 3 stops at the second read (stale Red) and the 3-read assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit test with checks [Red, Pending, Green], a completed failed run, merge_via_rest true; second case with it false.
demonstrations.observes: checks Green, reruns 1, merges 1 and merge_requested true when on; merges 0 when off.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the rerun, checks stay Red, no merge happens and the Green and merge assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Two unit tests: (a) checks [Red, Red(restarted), Red] with a failed job log containing `test gh::tests::x ... FAILED`; (b) checks always Pending.
demonstrations.observes: (a) merges 0, exactly one rerun_failed, report Red, failing_test Some("gh::tests::x"). (b) report Pending, reruns 0, 0 rerun calls, merges 0, reads equal attempts.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the single-rerun cap (a) calls rerun_failed more than once; without the name lookup failing_test is None; without the Pending path (b) a rerun or merge would occur.

demonstrations.method: Display unit tests on constructed PrReports: Red with test and rerun, Red with test and no rerun, Green after rerun, Red with unknown name; serde_json::to_value check of JSON fields.
demonstrations.observes: Text names the test and says the failed job was re-run once; Red message names the test when reruns is 0; JSON has failing_test and reruns.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the new display branches the Red text stays 'a check failed; nothing was merged' and the name assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: gh.rs parser test on a sample log (timestamp-prefixed line, `---- name stdout ----` fallback, rejected odd name); external_calls.rs test drives rerun_failed through the Injecting runner; docs table lists each new call with required state and reply when missing (rerun-failed-jobs: refused while the run is in progress, 404 for unknown run, empty 201 on success; the exact in-progress status is to be confirmed from GitHub docs).
demonstrations.observes: Runner sees POST repos/example/project/actions/runs/{id}/rerun-failed-jobs; a one-off 500 is retried with a retry line; a refusal is recorded in the host error log under read-checks; parser returns expected names.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the call bypassed api, no retry line or log entry would appear and the injected-500 test fails; with no parser the name assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the full suite, clippy and fmt as the checks Athena runs; the new tests are part of the suite, so they must pass for it to be green.
demonstrations.observes: Tests exit 0 including the new gh and display tests; then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` exit 0 with no warnings.
demonstrations.fails_without: If any new test, a trait implementor (FakeHost or GhClient) or the new PrReport fields were left inconsistent, the workspace would fail to compile or a test would fail; an unused item, needless clone or unformatted code would make clippy -D warnings or fmt --check exit non-zero.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the diff of both files.
demonstrations.observes: native-pr-landing.md has a section on the wait on Red, completion precondition, single rerun, look budget and failing-test report, plus the table of new calls; CHANGELOG.md has an entry under the unreleased heading.
